SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC) rownum, QNA_ID, TITLE, QSTN, ANS, ANSR, QSTNR, COALESCE(M.MBR_NM,'') AS AMDR_NM, TO_CHAR(QSTN_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS QSTN_DT, QNA_STTUS_CD, COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS QNA_STTUS_NM, SHOW_YN FROM KOA_TB_QNA A LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (A.QNA_STTUS_CD = D.COMN_CD AND D.GROUP_CD = 'QNASTS1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_MBR M ON (A.QSTNR = M.MBR_ID) WHERE SHOW_YN = 'Y'
AND UPPER(TITLE) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%'
AND UPPER(QSTN) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%'
AND (UPPER(TITLE) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%' OR UPPER(QSTN) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM KOA_TB_QNA WHERE SHOW_YN = 'Y'
AND UPPER(TITLE) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%'
AND UPPER(QSTN) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%'
AND (UPPER(TITLE) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%' OR UPPER(QSTN) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')

SELECT B.QNA_ID, B.TITLE, B.QSTN, B.ANS, B.ANSR, COALESCE(M.MBR_NM,'') AS AMDR_NM, B.QSTNR AS REGR, TO_CHAR(B.QSTN_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS QSTN_DT, TO_CHAR(B.ANS_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS ANS_DT, B.QNA_STTUS_CD, B.SHOW_YN, B.PREV_QNA_ID, B.NEXT_QNA_ID, B.PREV_TITLE, B.NEXT_TITLE FROM ( SELECT A.* , LAG(A.QNA_ID, 1, 0) OVER ( ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC) AS PREV_QNA_ID , LEAD(A.QNA_ID, 1, 0) OVER ( ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC) AS NEXT_QNA_ID , LAG(A.TITLE, 1, '') OVER ( ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC) AS PREV_TITLE , LEAD(A.TITLE, 1, '') OVER ( ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC) AS NEXT_TITLE FROM KOA_TB_QNA A WHERE SHOW_YN = 'Y' ) B LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_MBR M ON (B.QSTNR = M.MBR_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND B.QNA_ID = #{qnaId}
/* com.kt.openapi.web.qna.dao.QnADAO.checkOwnQna */ SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM KOA_TB_QNA WHERE (AMDR = #{amdr}) AND (QNA_ID = #{qnaId})

SELECT ATC_FILE_NO, QNA_ID, FILE_TYPE_CD, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, ORIGIN_FILE_NM, SAVE_FILE_NM, USE_YN, DOWNL_CNT, SHOW_ODRG, REG_DT, COALESCE(REGR,'') AS REGR, AMD_DT, COALESCE(AMDR,'') AS AMDR FROM KOA_TB_QNA_ATC WHERE 1=1 AND QNA_ID = #{qnaId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
